note: C5 Loop. before_X_W = a radar lit span on an enemy destroyer, attributed to a radar of the smoking team, overlapped the W seconds before the smoke was activated. any = anywhere on the map; near = while that destroyer was within 3 km of the edge of the cap nearest to the smoke. base = share of the moments between the game's first and last smoke (cut at the smoker's death) at which the same test is true (exact, no random draws). earlier / later = the round 5 control windows (120 to 60 s before; 60 to 120 s after). after = same test for the W seconds after activation; afterstart = a lit span began in those W seconds.
